title: dcm: Update to DICOM Edition 2020e
description: A minor change in upstream DICOM Standard DocBook syntax required a change in tools/make-packet-dcm.py as well.

notes.body: changed title from **Update to DICOM Edition 2020e** to **{+dcm: +}Update to DICOM Edition 2020e**
